openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation reported. Base is Kyiv; KMU's 2022 brochure describes operations as 'KYIV | KHARKIV | DNIPRO' and a 'Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences' consortium unit (est. 2017) - status of the Kharkiv/Dnipro operations after 2022 not found. A registered branch in Poland ('KMU Polish Campus', Katowice agglomeration) is described on kmu.edu.ua; Business Ombudsman (2022) says 'Polish authorities later approved the branch'; EBRD lent 'up to EUR 2.5 million' to finish it (Avellum / EBRD project 54412, date not shown in snippet). 2026 admission sessions announced on kmu.edu.ua: 'from April, 23 till April, 30' and 'from July, 6 and till November, 1'. All search-result leads.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Inventory flag 'licence and accreditation questions' remains open: the only licence lead is KMU's own 2016 strategic plan (licence for 221/222/226); no current MES licence register or EDEBO entry surfaced; DEQAR shows the 2022 Pharmacy accreditation decision as 'positive with conditions or restrictions'.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Polish campus: KMU's CLARIFICATIONS.pdf (2022/08) says Polish teaching is run 'on license and accreditation certificates issued for Kyiv Medical University' (i.e. Ukrainian certificates used for teaching inside the EU); no Polish regulator record (POL-on / Polish ministry register of foreign branches) surfaced. Destination-country recognition of degrees earned at the Polish site is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: distinct from Bogomolets National Medical University (Kyiv, state, listed as bogomolets-national-medical-university) - search results mixed the two; also confusable with 'Kyiv International University' (ruwiki result) and with the state 'Kyiv Medical Professional College' (the only MES document in the results was a college licensing table, not KMU).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Older name 'Kyiv Medical University of UAFM' and a founding focus on 'folk and alternative medicine' (own history page: 'Doctor of Folk and Alternative Medicine' specialty launched 1998) - may raise questions with recognition bodies; the UAFM expansion is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Conflicting third-party fee figures (US$4,000/yr medicine; 3,800 dentistry; 3,100 pharmacy from aggregators) and conflicting enrolment figures (Wikipedia ~3,900 vs 2022 brochure ~3,200) - none from an official current page; Wikipedia article is flagged 'multiple issues'.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Kharkiv and Dnipro operations and the 'Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences' consortium unit: status after the 2022 invasion not found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Self-ranking claims ('best private university (according to the Rankings-2019)', 'top-ranked private institution') come from KMU's own marketing PDFs; not independent.
